reason: The cited code reads build log metadata/content via a connection-backed Build API and returns it to the agent, so it supports SECRET because build logs are SaaS/project data accessed through the configured connection. The get_content path returns build log lines, which are external pipeline output and can contain attacker-controlled text, supporting UNTRUSTED. There is no arbitrary host code execution, and the code only reads from the API and returns to the caller; it does not send agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination, so HOSTEXEC and SINK are not supported.
